# Vendored crates

| Crate | Upstream | Why | Remove when |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ironrdp-server` 0.13.0 | [Devolutions/IronRDP](https://github.com/Devolutions/IronRDP) (Apache-2.0 OR MIT) | (1) Mouse PDU mapping in `src/handler.rs`: horizontal wheel, middle button, X1/X2 buttons. (2) AND mask derived from alpha for 32 bpp pointers (`src/encoder/pointer_mask.rs`, copied from master), without which Windows App for macOS ignores our cursor shapes. (3) `ServerEvent::CliprdrDriveTimeouts` (#2148): the clipboard lock/file timeouts are driven by a host timer. All mirror IronRDP master; search for `ClawTank patch`. | A published `ironrdp-server` release contains the fix (ADR-017) |
| `ironrdp-server` 0.14.0, revision `475e5d534f0afa080e51b940caf3d7c1f9d6ec6c` | Opt-in structured metadata for only the first legacy bitmap update in a session; logs serialized tile headers and lengths without pixel/compressed payloads. Uses the Android-compatible byte count for RDP 6.0 32-bpp `cbScanWidth`. Adds an `EgfxTransportObserver` callback fired only after EGFX output has actually moved to reliable UDP, so ClawTank can expose TCP/UDP state without parsing logs. | Upstream provides equivalent metadata, Android-compatible scan width and transport-state observer, or the Android bitmap issue is resolved |
| `ironrdp-acceptor` 0.12.0, revision `475e5d534f0afa080e51b940caf3d7c1f9d6ec6c` | Initial activation preserves valid Fast-Path, I/O-channel and static-channel frames received before Confirm Active, then replays them after finalization. Upstream commit `eea9abea` has this behavior for reactivation only. The patch also exposes a typed CredSSP credential-rejection check for lockout accounting. | Upstream applies the pre-confirm backlog to initial activation and provides equivalent typed authentication classification |

Only the lines marked `ClawTank patch` differ from the crates.io release. `diff -r` against `~/.cargo/registry/src/*/ironrdp-server-0.13.0` to verify.
